import ast,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base='01c96abeab2be25ff38176357a19fb53f18356f8'
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base],text=True).splitlines()
private=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','2fcc457:docs/m0/host.json'],text=True))['workspace']
rows=[];redacted=[]
for name in files:
 if not (name.startswith(('docs/m4/','tests/m4','scripts/m4')) or name in ['flash/localization.py','flash/profile_input.py','tasks/04_localization.md']):continue
 old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+name]);new=Path(name).read_bytes()
 if old!=new:
  assert name.startswith('docs/m4/') or name=='scripts/m4_replay.py',name
  normalized=old.decode().replace(private,'<project>').replace('gpu-'+'01','node-0').replace('gpu-'+'02','node-1').encode()
  assert normalized==new,name
  if name.endswith('.py'):assert ast.dump(ast.parse(old))==ast.dump(ast.parse(new)),name
  redacted.append(name)
 else:rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()})
assert Path('PLAN.md').read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':PLAN.md'])
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=U'],text=True)
s=Path('STATUS.md').read_text();assert s.startswith('# FLASH 全新开发状态\n\n当前阶段：M4')
assert all(x in s for x in ['## M4最终结果与停止','## P1 隐私审查'])
result={'status':'PASS','main_commit':base,'unchanged_m4_files':len(rows),'identity_only_files':redacted,'replay_AST':'identical','plan':'identical_to_main','unmerged_paths':0,'files':rows}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
